title: Data Quality Analyst
jd_text: Ready to be a Titan? ServiceTitan is looking for a Data Quality Analyst to join our Data Engineering department. Strong candidates will have basic knowledge of the SQL server, TSQL, and ETL operations in addition to strong analytical and critical thinking skills. This is a customer-facing role. You will be guiding customers as a technical expert, and while you will be expected to technically proficient, this is not an engineering role. The most critical portion of the role is working with the customer to deconstruct and re-interpret their data so they can migrate to ServiceTitan successfully. The candidate will work closely with cross-departmental resources to ensure on-time delivery of transferred data for customers adoption of ServiceTitan.The Data Quality Analyst will receive projects and deadlines from the Data Engineering or Implementation Departments. The ability to own tasks, clearly communicate requirements, delays, completion and prioritize a constantly shifting schedule of deadlines is paramount. The candidate will work directly with a customer when evaluating new software to review the data in its source software, present cleanups to the larger data team, and work cross functionally between client, data engineer, and Onboarder. This work is highly critical to our implementation process and in reducing overall data migration time. It is the lynchpin of the sales and onboarding process. Data concerns are a blocker for most of our customers, so delivering high-quality, highly accurate transfers is absolutely crucial and greatly appreciated by both our customers and our company. What you'll do: 60% of your time will be spent working with customers, 40% doing technical work. Work directly with customers to ensure their data migration is a success. Manage a wide variety of tasks with shifting priorities and tight deadlines Clearly communicate project status and updates with internal and external stakeholders in a timely manner for successful delivery. Find and employ methods for transferring sources of data we have not previously encountered Evaluate and understand database structures and interpret them into ServiceTitan data model Write queries to correct, reformat or move data What you'll bring: Be proficient in Excel Basic knowledge and experience in T-SQL Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. Able to identify relationships within databases and infer the developers intent based on structure and values Ability to work effectively within a team environment with tight deadlines and high expectations" Be Human With Us: Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. Use of AI Technology: We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. What We Offer: When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work : Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more. Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. title: Solutions Architect - Data Governance
jd_text: About Us Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services. Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy: Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S. Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities. Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family. World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours. Job Summary The Solutions Architect, Data Governance serves as the lead technical and strategic advisor for enterprise data governance initiatives within client engagements. This role works directly with executive stakeholders, data leaders, business teams, security organizations, and technical delivery teams to design and implement governance programs that establish trust, visibility, accountability, and control across enterprise data estates. This client-facing delivery role focuses on structured data governance, including metadata management, business glossary development, taxonomy design, data lineage, stewardship operating models, data quality frameworks, governance monitoring, and Microsoft Purview implementation. The Solutions Architect defines governance strategy, designs governance architectures, leads customer engagements, and provides oversight throughout delivery of the governance workstream. This role also advises organizations on governance readiness for modern analytics and AI platforms, including Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Data Services, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. Role Description Data Governance Strategy and Architecture Act as the lead subject matter expert for enterprise data governance, Microsoft Purview, metadata management, taxonomy development, and governance operating model design. Lead governance discovery workshops, maturity assessments, roadmap engagements, and executive strategy sessions. Design enterprise governance frameworks including stewardship models, ownership structures, governance policies, business glossaries, taxonomy standards, and metadata management processes. Microsoft Purview Governance Leadership Architect and oversee implementation of Microsoft Purview Data Governance capabilities including Unified Catalog, Data Map, Data Estate Insights, data lineage, metadata management, and business glossary solutions. Establish governance standards for structured data assets across Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Services, Power BI, SQL Server, Snowflake, Azure Databricks, and related platforms. Guide customers in developing sustainable governance processes, governance operating procedures, and stewardship responsibilities. Customer Advisory and Governance Transformation Serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, data leaders, governance councils, and technical teams. Translate business objectives, regulatory considerations, and operational requirements into scalable governance solutions. Lead customer-facing workshops, architecture reviews, roadmap discussions, and governance design sessions. Governance Operations and Monitoring Design governance monitoring and operational reporting solutions utilizing Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and related observability platforms. Establish operational processes for governance measurement, stewardship accountability, data quality reporting, lineage monitoring, and governance adoption tracking. Contribute governance accelerators, reference architectures, and reusable delivery assets from engagement experience. Apply the practice's delivery standards and AI-accelerated delivery patterns on engagements and identify opportunities for improvement based on real-world client conditions. AI Readiness Advise organizations on governance readiness for Microsoft 365 Copilot and enterprise AI initiatives. Assess metadata maturity, lineage coverage, ownership models, and governance controls required to support effective and responsible AI adoption. Behaviors and Competencies This role is expected to demonstrate expert-level capability within data governance and strong capability across the following areas: Subject Matter Expertise: Recognized depth in enterprise data governance, with sufficient understanding of data platforms to evaluate governance implications and identify risks in adjacent workstreams. Facilitation: Leads discovery, maturity assessment, and governance design sessions to resolution, including situations involving disagreement over ownership or governance scope. Communication: Explains governance concepts, trade-offs, and obligations to executive sponsors, business stewards, and technical teams while tailoring communication to the audience. Relationship Management: Builds trust with executive sponsors, governance councils, and data stewards and sustains relationships through long-term governance initiatives. Collaboration: Works across delivery teams, security organizations, and business units, measuring success by governance adoption rather than artifact delivery. Problem Solving: Identifies and resolves root causes that hinder governance initiatives, including unclear ownership, ineffective incentives, or inadequate tooling. Skill Level Requirements We are looking for candidates who demonstrate strength across these areas. Deep expertise in every technology listed is not expected. Candidates should not self-select out if they do not meet every qualification. Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Data Management, Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. Seven or more years of experience delivering enterprise data, information management, or data governance solutions, with substantial recent focus on governance. Hands-on implementation experience with Microsoft Purview, including Unified Catalog, Data Map, Data Estate Insights, business glossary, metadata management, and data lineage. Demonstrated experience establishing data stewardship programs, including executive sponsorship, ownership structures, accountability frameworks, and adoption strategies. Demonstrated experience leading customer-facing consulting engagements, executive workshops, governance assessments, and strategic advisory initiatives. Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, and Azure. Experience with data engineering and data visualization architectures and their relationship to governance. Strong understanding of data governance frameworks and governance reporting. Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Skills and Experience Experience with Azure Databricks and Unity Catalog, including governance and cataloging across Azure-based lakehouse environments. Experience supporting Microsoft 365 Copilot enablement, AI governance frameworks, and enterprise AI adoption initiatives. Experience with agentic systems such as Microsoft Foundry and Copilot Studio. Experience designing governance monitoring solutions utilizing Azure Monitor and Azure Log Analytics. Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and CI/CD practices supporting data and analytics platforms. Experience working within regulated industries including healthcare, financial services, insurance, manufacturing, or public sector organizations. Other Requirements Ability to travel to SHI, partner, and customer locations as needed. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with sales, delivery, engineering, and leadership stakeholders. Commitment to continuous learning across data governance, analytics, and AI platforms. Strong ethical standards with disciplined adherence to data privacy, governance, compliance, and security requirements. The estimated annual pay range for this position is $140,000 - $225,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending. Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

title: Principal Architect - Databricks
jd_text: About Us Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services. Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy: Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S. Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities. Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family. World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours. Job Summary We are expanding our Databricks capability within the Data and AI practice and are looking for a Principal Solutions Architect to lead the technical side of it. You will work directly with customers from the outset, qualifying opportunities, conducting technical discovery with customer architects and data leaders, designing target-state platforms, and owning the technical win. Much of the work ahead involves platform build-out, migration, and consolidation, helping enterprises move to the Databricks Lakehouse from Hadoop and Spark estates, legacy analytics platforms, established data warehouse and appliance environments, and other cloud platforms. The role also supports AI and machine learning initiatives that Databricks is designed to enable. This is a senior individual contributor position with significant influence over the solutions we build and bring to market. It is ideal for someone who wants to shape a capability rather than operate within one that is already defined. Role Description Own the Technical Side of Databricks Pursuits Lead qualification, technical discovery, target architecture design, effort estimation, and risk assessment. Develop technical content for proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs). Build and maintain technical relationships with customer architects and stakeholders. Provide customers with realistic and accurate assessments of migration complexity, implementation effort, AI workload readiness, and associated risks. Provide Architectural Oversight Through Delivery Review architecture decisions throughout project delivery. Confirm that the delivered solution aligns with what was originally scoped and proposed. Surface technical risks and issues early in the engagement. Remain closely involved throughout delivery to ensure accountability for architecture and outcomes. Shape Databricks Service Offerings Define the technical content of market-facing Databricks offerings. Establish what is included in scope, how success is measured, and what evidence validates successful completion. Create repeatable delivery standards and frameworks that teams can execute consistently. Partner with Databricks Engage directly with Databricks field teams and specialist architects on joint customer accounts. Build productive relationships with Databricks technical teams. Effectively collaborate and navigate technical challenges, feedback, and differing viewpoints from vendor architects and specialists. Behaviors and Competencies Willingness to Learn: Can apply new learning to daily work, encourage and facilitate learning in others, and actively make changes to work based on feedback. Self-Development: Can demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and adaptability to new ideas and methods. Leadership: Can take ownership of complex team initiatives, collaborate with others in decision-making processes, and drive team performance. Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, anticipate future trends, and align and integrate strategies across departments or functions. Problem-Solving: Can proactively identify and take ownership of complex problem-solving initiatives, initiate preventative measures, collaborate with others to find solutions, and drive successful outcomes. Analytical Thinking: Can use advanced analytical techniques to solve complex problems, draw insights, and communicate the solutions effectively. Prioritization: Can take ownership of complex task management, collaborate with others to align priorities, and drive team efficiency. Customer-Centric Mindset: Can take ownership of customer-centric initiatives, ensuring products and services align with customer needs. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate customer feedback into product development. Organization: Can oversee complex projects with multiple moving parts, ensure team alignment with organizational systems, and adapt to changing priorities. Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences, facilitate effective communication between others, and mentor others in effective communication. Interpersonal Skills: Can communicate effectively, build relationships, resolve conflicts, influence others, and support others in developing their interpersonal skills in major situations. Skill Level Requirements Lakehouse Platform and Architecture Account and workspace design Unity Catalog and metastore architecture Compute strategy across interactive, jobs, and serverless workloads Open table format decisions Cost architecture and design choices that affect long-term scalability and affordability The ability to design platforms that remain technically and financially sustainable at enterprise scale is critical. Migration and Consolidation Migrating organizations from Hadoop and Spark environments Modernizing legacy analytics and statistical platforms Consolidating established warehouses and appliance-based solutions Migrating workloads from other cloud platforms Key areas of expertise include: Platform assessments Wave planning and migration strategy Workload and code conversion Reconciliation and parity validation Cutover planning and execution This is expected to represent a significant portion of the work within the practice and requires genuine expertise rather than general familiarity. Data Engineering and Pipelines Batch data ingestion Streaming data ingestion Declarative pipeline development Workflow orchestration Testing and validation frameworks Data quality instrumentation Building and operating reliable, production-ready data engineering solutions Machine Learning and AI Engineering Feature engineering Experiment tracking Model registry and serving Evaluation and validation frameworks Retrieval and grounding architectures Agent development This represents one of Databricks’ key differentiators and is an area where many customers require assistance moving from proof-of-concept solutions to production-grade, supportable implementations. Governance at the Perimeter Catalog-based access controls Data classification Data masking Data lineage and governance frameworks Candidates should understand how Databricks governance integrates with enterprise governance strategies and be able to address challenges that exist across organizational and platform boundaries. Consumption Economics Compute sizing strategies Workload placement optimization Serverless versus classic compute trade-offs Consumption attribution and chargeback models Cost management and optimization practices Candidates must be comfortable discussing platform costs with customers and providing practical guidance on controlling and forecasting consumption. Technical Depth Expectations Candidates do not need to be equally strong across all six areas; however, they must possess: Deep expertise in lakehouse architecture and platform design Deep expertise in migration and consolidation Deep expertise in data engineering Sufficient proficiency in the remaining areas to recognize when specialist support should be engaged Other Requirements Databricks Expertise Substantial hands-on Databricks experience gained through: A Databricks partner organization Databricks directly Managing a significant Databricks Lakehouse environment internally This role requires Databricks-specific expertise rather than general data platform leadership experience. Enterprise Migration and Consolidation Experience Proven success delivering enterprise-scale migration and consolidation initiatives. Ability to discuss at least one major migration project in detail, including lessons learned and outcomes. Production Machine Learning and AI Experience Experience operating and supporting production machine learning or AI solutions. Expertise beyond proof-of-concept implementations. Demonstrated understanding of the operational, governance, and maintenance considerations required for production AI workloads. Principal-Level Technical Leadership Proven success operating at Principal Architect level or equivalent. Recognized as the senior technical authority in customer engagements. Trusted to commit organizations to scopes, architectures, and technical approaches. Presales Experience Experience in presales environments, or Delivery leadership experience demonstrating the ability to: Lead customer discussions Define scope and solution approaches Develop proposals and Statements of Work Stand behind technical commitments made during the sales process Vendor Collaboration Comfortable working with and being challenged by vendor architects and technical specialists. Certifications Databricks certification preferred. Ability to obtain certification quickly if not currently certified. Certification support and funding are provided. The estimated annual pay range for this position is $195,000 - $250,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending. Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

title: Manager, Global Revenue Planning and Strategy (Remote)
jd_text: We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Global Revenue Planning & Strategy to join Procore’s Revenue Operations (Global Revenue Strategy & Planning) team. In this role, you’ll serve as the lead architect and program manager for our global annual revenue planning engine. Your primary goal will be to own the end-to-end methodology, drivers-based bookings modeling, capacity architecture, and financial governance that underpin a ~2,000-person GTM organization. As a Senior Manager, Global Revenue Planning & Strategy , you’ll partner with Sales VPs, GMs, FP&A, Corporate Strategy, and Planning Operations to translate macro corporate growth targets into executable capacity models, drivers-based bookings forecasts, segment allocation frameworks, and audit-ready planning submissions. Use your drivers-based financial modeling, GTM capacity planning, and executive cross-functional leadership skills to elevate revenue planning into a repeatable enterprise asset and drive strategic revenue decisions. Join a fast-growing, industry-leading software organization and reshape global GTM planning at scale. This position reports into the Sr. Director, Revenue Operations and can be based remotely in the US. We’re looking for someone to join us immediately. What you’ll do: Serve as the Global Program Lead for the annual revenue planning cycle (AOP), orchestrating cross-functional workstreams across Executive Leadership, FP&A, Corporate Strategy, and Revenue Operations. Own the global planning methodology, governance framework, and milestone execution across initial Rev Plan iterations, Finance soft looks, and Final Plan Lock. Architect and institutionalize the Global Planning Playbook, establishing standardized SOPs, data dictionaries, and operational frameworks. Oversee the end-to-end architecture of drivers-based bookings models spanning New Logo ARR, Pipeline Conversion, Renewal Book Retention/Churn, Expansion, and Professional Services. Build and refine global headcount, capacity, and costing models to ensure optimal seller coverage, realistic ramp profiles, and efficient seller-to-capacity ratios. Operationalize ACV-based GTM segmentation structures across SMB, Owners, and Global/Enterprise categories while overseeing the Segmentation Translation Table and Seed File. Partner with Marketing and SDR/ISR leadership to establish aligned top-of-funnel pipeline generation, SQL targets, and lead-to-opportunity conversion baselines. Establish standardized submission templates, data reconciliation workflows, and reporting bridges connecting sales capacity to FP&A financial targets. What we’re looking for: 6+ years in Revenue Operations, Strategic Finance, FP&A, or GTM Strategy at a fast-growing B2B Enterprise SaaS company, with prior people management experience. Proven track record supporting a multi-hundred-million-dollar ARR business with large direct sales teams. Advanced expertise in drivers-based financial modeling, capacity planning, headcount costing, and revenue retention economics (GRR, NRR, Churn, Expansion). Heavy hands-on experience with Salesforce (SFDC), CPQ, Enterprise Data Warehouses/BI Tools (Tableau, PowerBI), and advanced financial modeling platforms. Exceptional executive communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex quantitative models into decisive presentations for C-suite and VP audiences. Prior experience managing multi-product revenue models and M&A integration frameworks within an enterprise software environment. Deep knowledge of construction-tech software market dynamics or multi-tier GTM motions (SMB, Mid-Market, Strategic/Enterprise, Public/Private Owners). Additional Information Base Pay Range: 144,000.00 - 198,000.00 USD Annual This role may also be eligible for Equity Compensation and/or Bonus Incentive Compensation. Procore is committed to offering competitive, fair, and commensurate compensation. Actual compensation will be based on a candidate’s job-related skills, experience, education or training, and location. For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates: Procore will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the requirements of applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. A criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: 1. appropriately managing, accessing, and handling confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information, as well as accessing Procore's information technology systems and platforms; 2. interacting with and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external customers, stakeholders, and/or colleagues; and 3. exercising sound judgment.

title: AI Deployment Specialist (Remote)
jd_text: Procore is hiring an AI Deployment Specialist to take our AI products into the field — deploying agentic solutions alongside construction teams, architecting custom builds, and driving adoption and measurable value inside strategic and enterprise accounts. As an AI Deployment Specialist, you are the person who makes Procore's AI real for customers. You partner directly with construction teams to deploy agentic solutions, architect custom builds against their workflows, and drive usage from first pilot through full value realization. You sit at the intersection of deep product knowledge, hands-on technical ability, and genuine construction domain fluency — translating an AI vision into systems that hold up on live projects. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with forward-deployed engineers, account managers, customer success engineers, and solutions engineers to move use cases to adoption, and you'll bring what you learn in the field back to Product and Engineering to shape where the product goes next. Expect regular customer travel to lead workshops, hackathons, and executive reviews. This position reports into the Director of AI Solutions and is remote, with travel expected. We're looking for someone to join us immediately. What you'll do: Deliver complex programs of agentic AI solutions from requirements through production, translating customer needs into working systems that perform in the field. Lead AI deployments alongside construction project teams, driving adoption through technical depth, hands-on exception handling, sharp product positioning, and a deep understanding of construction workflows. Lead business architecture reviews to strategize, scope, and deliver custom AI solutions mapped to each customer's operating model. Engage directly with customer construction data — project records, documents, RFIs, submittals, drawings, schedules, and financials — to assess data readiness and design the pipelines that feed AI. Structure and connect disparate sources into knowledge graphs that ground agentic solutions in accurate, retrievable context, and put in place the data-quality and governance practices that keep them reliable at scale. Build simple to moderately complex AI solutions yourself, drawing on hands-on technical ability and an expert, end-to-end command of the Procore product. Lead strategic conversations with key decision-makers, helping them shape and realize their AI vision and scale it across their construction organization. Travel to customer sites to lead workshops, hackathons, and executive reviews, communicating Procore's AI vision — both where it is today and where it's headed. Partner closely with forward-deployed engineers to move customer use cases from concept to adoption and measurable value. Work cross-functionally with account managers, customer success engineers, and solutions engineers to position AI products for growth across strategic and enterprise accounts. title: Principal Enterprise Applications Architect
jd_text: We are looking for a Principal Enterprise Applications Architect to serve as a strategic technical leader for our corporate back-office ecosystem and spearhead large-scale application and business process transformation. In this role, you will align business strategies with enterprise technical architecture across our Finance, HR, and Legal domains, reimagining end-to-end workflows to ensure a seamless, automated flow of information from upstream Go-To-Market (GTM) systems. We need a hands-on, deeply technical visionary who can architect complex cross-platform integrations and system workflows across a modern, best-of-breed enterprise application stack. You will engineer scalable, enterprise-grade integration services using modern iPaaS frameworks, lead comprehensive process modernization efforts to eliminate operational friction, and actively accelerate business velocity by introducing AI-driven automation into our day-to-day operations. What You’ll Do Architect the Back Office: Serve as a technical authority for our core back-office ecosystem, including Workday, NetSuite, Zuora, Zip, Xactly, and Ironclad and other applications to ensure system scalability, data integrity, and tight alignment with end-to-end data flows. Build the Bridges: Design, code, and deploy robust, reusable application integrations and services using Workato or similar integration tooling to connect disparate boundary systems into a unified, automated engine. Drive AI Transformation: Champion the practical application of AI within our corporate systems. You will lead the charge in deploying AI/LLM connectors and workflow automation to strengthen operating controls and eliminate manual bottlenecks. Translate & Execute: Partner closely with executive business stakeholders across Finance, HR, Legal, and GTM to translate strategic business capabilities into bulletproof technical requirements and end-to-end system design specifications. Drive Process & Integration Simplification: Optimize the end-to-end back-office data lifecycle to reduce architectural complexity and maximize efficiency. Streamline integrations so data flows seamlessly from upstream GTM platforms through legal compliance, the Hire-to-Retire lifecycle, and into core billing and financial systems, eliminating operational friction and manual overhead. Mentor and Lead: Act as a technical mentor to business systems analysts and engineers, setting the gold standard for clean architecture, integration best practices, and innovative problem-solving. What We’re Looking For The Experience: 15+ years of progressive technical experience in enterprise applications engineering, with a heavy emphasis on core corporate back-office systems. Cross-Domain Technical Leadership: Proven, hands-on technical architecture and engineering experience across Workday, coupled with deep experience integrating and extending robust finance, procurement, and legal systems (e.g. NetSuite, Zuora, Zip, Xactly, and Ironclad). You bring a holistic, company-wide technical perspective rather than a siloed application specialization. Technical Design & Execution: A proven track record of writing detailed technical specifications, designing robust error-handling frameworks, and executing complex software rollouts across multi-dimensional teams. Integration Mastery: Deep expertise in enterprise integration patterns and extensive hands-on experience building complex workflows using Workato (or similar enterprise iPaaS platforms), complemented by strong scripting / coding skills. Compliance & Governance: Strong understanding of SOX compliance, IT General Controls (ITGCs), and segregation of duties (SoD). Proven ability to architect, enforce, and embed highly effective, automated technical controls directly into application designs and integration pipelines to ensure audit-readiness without introducing unnecessary operational friction. AI Practicality: Early but proven proficiency in applying AI within the business applications space. You can demonstrate how you’ve leveraged generative AI, LLM frameworks, or intelligent automation tools to solve real-world corporate workflow challenges. Domain & GTM Awareness: Deep functional understanding of Finance, HR, and Legal business processes, combined with a strong working knowledge of how these systems interface with upstream GTM platforms (e.g. Salesforce). Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills with the unique ability to dive deep into technical code with engineers, and then pivot to present a high-level strategic roadmap to business stakeholders. Additional Information Base Pay Range: 233,360.00 - 320,870.00 USD Annual This role may also be eligible for Equity Compensation and/or Bonus Incentive Compensation. title: Senior Manager, Financial Business Planning Operation
jd_text: Position Summary This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship Headquartered in Plano, TX, Samsung Electronics America (SEA) is a leader in mobile technologies, consumer electronics, home appliances, enterprise solutions and networks systems. Across each of these areas, our work drives innovation, economic growth and workforce opportunity in the United States. For nearly five decades, Samsung has been at the forefront of technological advancements, investing over $100 billion and creating more than 20,000 jobs nationwide. Our mission? To integrate cutting-edge products, services, and AI technology to deliver smarter, sustainable, and more connected experiences that empower people to live better. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., SEA offers opportunities to work alongside global visionary thinkers and innovators who are passionate about making a difference. Explore the exciting opportunities at Samsung Electronics America and discover how you can make an impact. To learn more, visit Samsung.com. For the latest news, visit news.samsung.com/us. CE eCommerce Team Values & Principles • Detail-oriented with AI-Augmented (AX) support — we use Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI daily. • Results-driven: every decision is grounded in data, and every initiative ships with a measurable outcome. • Innovative and experimentative — we test boldly, learn fast, and scale what works. • AX transformation is embedded in all day-to-day activities; AI tools replace traditional reliance on static spreadsheets. Role and Responsibilities About This Opportunity This is the financial nerve center of a business that needs one. The CE eCommerce Hub spans TV, Audio, Monitor, Refrigeration, Laundry, and Cooking — direct-to-consumer business. As CE begins scaling its Expansion Commerce channels, this role ensures every dollar is forecasted, tracked, and optimized with rigor. The Sr. Manager, CE Financial Business Planning & Operations will own SKU-level revenue forecasting, T-series financial submissions, weekly A/R reporting, promotional financial modeling, and the analytics infrastructure that powers the CE Weekly Business Review and LOB reporting. Position Summary The Sr. Manager, CE Financial Business Planning & Operations will lead financial forecasting, business planning, supply chain financial alignment, and analytics for the full CE eCommerce portfolio — including VD (TV, Audio, Monitor) and DA (Refrigerator, Laundry, Cooking, Dishwasher) — and will model the financial impact of CE's Expansion Commerce channel launches. This role partners with Category Management, LOB Finance, PSI/BOPIS, and Marketing to ensure the CE eCommerce business operates with financial discipline and full P&L visibility. Roles & Responsibilities FINANCIAL PLANNING & FORECASTING · Own SKU-level revenue forecasts and Monthly Financial Plans across all CE BUs (TV, Audio, Monitor, DA sub-categories) — submitting T-series updates (T07, T08, etc.) aligned with LOB and SEA Finance timelines. · Lead CPFR (Collaborative Planning, Forecasting, and Replenishment) calls with PSI and BOPIS teams alongside Category Management — ensuring eCommerce demand signals are accurately reflected in supply chain planning. · Develop QCD Plans (Demand Revenue, Financial Revenue, SD, Profit %) for CE eCommerce, updated in response to promotional plans, marketing changes, and channel mix shifts. · Report weekly Achievement Rates (A/R = SUM actuals / SUM forecast) to CE WBR and prepare SCM content for LOB leadership. PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS & REPORTING · Analyze traffic, CVR (Conversion Rate), and funnel performance versus marketing forecast — identifying gaps by BU, category, and channel, and reporting recommendations to Category Management. · Manage CE eCommerce aging and transfer price (TP) accuracy metrics, collaborating with Fulfillment on in-stock performance and forecasting accuracy targets. · Build and maintain KPI dashboards using Tableau, SQL, and AI-augmented analytics workflows for real-time CE business performance visibility. · Produce executive-ready financial summaries for CE WBR, monthly LOB reviews, and strategic planning cycles. INVENTORY & SUPPLY CHAIN OPTIMIZATION · Address backorders and inventory supply issues across CE categories (CTN model planning + new SKU forecast management) in close coordination with Category Managers. · Lead CE demand forecasting using advanced modeling techniques — ARIMA, exponential smoothing, and machine learning models — to align eCommerce sell-out with upstream supply chain planning. · Utilize predictive analytics to anticipate demand fluctuations, minimize stockout and excess inventory exposure, and recommend inventory repositioning strategies. PROMOTIONAL & FINANCIAL ANALYSIS · Create financial program templates for promotional lift assessment and profitability analysis across all CE BU-level promotional events — ensuring Finance alignment before execution. · Employ A/B testing, hypothesis testing, and ROI analysis to evaluate promotional effectiveness — generating learnings that refine targeting, depth, and timing of future programs. · Model the financial impact of Expansion channel launches (Marketplace, Carrier, Social, FinTech) on overall CE eCommerce revenue mix and margin profile. STRATEGIC REVENUE MANAGEMENT · Own financial business planning to achieve quarterly and annual revenue targets across the CE eCommerce portfolio — aligned with the roadmap. · Develop analytical frameworks using machine learning and statistical modeling to identify growth opportunities by BU, product family, channel, and season. · Leverage LLM/AI tools to accelerate financial modeling, scenario analysis, and executive reporting — replacing traditional spreadsheet workflows with AI-native business intelligence. CONTRACTOR OVERSIGHT & TEAM OPERATIONS · Manage and direct one financial/analytics contractor, setting priorities, reviewing output, and ensuring quality standards. · Develop standard operating procedures and reporting cadences that scale as the CE expansion business grows. · Partner with IT and Data Engineering to maintain and improve CE eCommerce data infrastructure and reporting pipelines. Skills and Qualifications Minimum Qualifications · Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related STEM field. · 10–12 years in financial planning, analytics, or a related quantitative field. · Strong expertise in demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and financial modeling for an eCommerce or retail business. · Proficiency in SQL, Tableau, and advanced data analysis techniques including regression analysis and time-series forecasting. · Experience leading cross-functional programs across sales, marketing, finance, and supply chain. Preferred Qualifications · Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related STEM field. · Experience with machine learning algorithms — ARIMA, exponential smoothing, neural networks, or gradient boosting models. · Background in consumer electronics, eCommerce, or retail financial planning. · Proven track record in strategic revenue management with documented quarterly business impact. · Experience with AI/LLM tools applied to financial modeling and business intelligence. · Prior experience managing contractors or junior analysts. #LI-RL2 Regular full-time employees (salaried or hourly) have access to benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, 401(k), Employee Purchase Program, Tuition Assistance (after 12 months), Paid Time Off, Student Loan Program (after 12 months), Wellness Incentives, and many more. In addition, regular full-time employees (salaried or hourly) are eligible for MBO bonus compensation, based on company, division, and individual performance. * Please visit Samsung membership to see Privacy Policy, which defaults according to your location. title: Operations Construction Manager
jd_text: At Prologis, we don’t just lead the industry—we define it with a 1.3 billion square foot portfolio and an annual throughput of approximately $3.2 trillion. We create the intelligent infrastructure that powers global commerce, seamlessly connecting the digital and physical worlds. From agile supply chains to energy solutions, our ecosystems help your business move faster, operate smarter and grow sustainably. With unmatched scale, innovation and expertise, Prologis is a category of one—not just shaping the future of logistics but building what comes next. Job Title: Operations Construction Manager Company: Prologis Operations Construction Manager – Houston A day in the life The Operations Construction Manager role is critical to ensuring our properties are move-in ready as soon as possible. If you enjoy coordinating and leading activities related to getting a property customer-ready, then this is the role for you. You will be responsible for identifying, coordinating and managing our tenant and capital improvement projects. As the Operations Construction Manager, you are an integral part of the Customer Experience Team (CET) working with your peers from leasing, property management, and maintenance to ensure our buildings remain best in class and our tenants receive world-class customer service. It also means having great relationship-building skills to build trusted partnerships with vendors, public agencies, customers and internal teams to ensure timely and coordinated delivery of our spaces. This role is perfectly positioned to optimize our real estate portfolio by having a deep understanding of the features and functions within our properties that influence rental behavior. This position reports to the local Market Officer with supplemental reporting to the Regional Construction Operations Team. Key responsibilities include: Support the CET as it’s subject matter expert on construction and construction related activities: - Provide updates and feedback on planned and in-progress projects - Work with the leasing teams on establishing budgets for tenant and market ready improvement projects Plan internal and external resources as required to coordinate and monitor the construction process including: - Hire and manage design professionals, consultants, contractors, and vendors - Develop schedules and provide conceptual and pre-construction estimates - Obtain competitive bids and conduct bid analysis, where required on Make Ready, Tenant and Capital Improvement projects - Work closely with construction procurement to leverage pricing support - Manage the procurement of permits and all necessary governmental approvals - Promote a culture of safety and ensure customer satisfaction on every project - Provide detailed project cost tracking for both hard and soft costs Support Essentials and Energy team through local oversight of the projects and execution of work to ensure quality delivery of projects and high customer satisfaction. Identify opportunities to upgrade and maximize the value of existing real estate portfolio via building enhancements such as façade renovations, building function, parking improvements, etc Building blocks for success Required: 5+ years of Project management experience with a commercial general contractor, real estate owner, and/or the owner’s representative preferred Aptitude for construction management, tenant improvement implementation or related educational background suitable for learning the trade. Experience or aptitude in Property Improvements, Roofing, Construction, Tenant Improvements and Renovations Proficient with or ability to quickly learn new technologies (i.e. Excel, MS Project, Google Earth, ACAD viewer, Bluebeam, and Smartsheet) Preferred: Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, or Engineering (Civil or Structural); or applicable and equivalent experience in the Construction Management field, Industrial Real Estate. Comfortable working under pressure and to tight deadlines, demonstrating exceptional problem-solving skills. Proficient with construction/project management software. Ability to identify opportunities for upgrading and maximizing the value of real estate portfolios. Experience in preparing and managing budgets, along with a strong understanding of financial and accounting principles. title: Senior Product Manager, Scheduling
jd_text: We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager, Scheduling to own a significant area of Procore Scheduling, our native scheduling solution built into the Procore platform. Construction schedules are built, shared, and used by many parties, and their tools are rarely connected. General contractors often keep a master schedule in Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project and plan short-term work in spreadsheets. Owners and specialty contractors receive those schedules but have their own scheduling needs. Procore Scheduling brings them together in one real-time, collaborative platform with a full CPM engine, lookahead planning, third-party imports, and deep connections to other Procore solutions. You’ll own the in-product schedule experience: how teams view, edit, and collaborate on schedules and lookaheads in Procore Scheduling. You’ll partner with your manager, who leads the broader Scheduling platform and its connections to other Procore solutions, including through AI. You’ll own the customer problems, priorities, and outcomes in your area, spend real time with customers, turn what you learn into clear requirements, and lead product in a tight partnership with Design and Engineering. Your scope is expected to grow as you deliver. If you want to build software that construction professionals rely on every day and care about getting the details of a complex product right, come join us. This position reports to the Head of Product, Schedule and is based in Austin, TX. What you'll do: Own the product strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for the in-product schedule experience: how teams view, edit, and collaborate on schedules and lookaheads in Procore Scheduling. Work within the platform your manager owns, and explain the "why" behind your priorities in clear written briefs Spend significant time with owners, specialty contractors, and general contractors, including schedulers, project controls professionals, and superintendents, to understand how each plans and tracks work, where schedules they receive from others fit in, and where their needs are unmet. Observe customers using the product in the real world, not just in interviews Run discovery independently, using a mix of customer interviews, usability testing, competitive analysis, and usage data, and turn the findings into insights your team and stakeholders can act on Write product requirements and acceptance criteria that account for outcome potential, competitive landscape, technical constraints, and user experience, including performance, reliability, and security Balance near-term improvements against a longer-term vision, and break larger initiatives into phases that deliver customer value along the way Lead your tripod with Design and Engineering, building momentum through influence and respect for each discipline's expertise Partner with your manager and with other measures, and adjust the plan based on what the data shows Communicate strategy, progress, and results clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership Mentor newer product managers and contribute to hiring panels for the Product team What success looks like in your first 12 to 18 months: You have built a deep understanding of scheduling customers and the construction scheduling workflows they title: Senior QA Engineer, Austin TX
jd_text: This role will work with our FedRAMP program and requires US Citizenship and onsite work in Austin, Texas. Want to be on a team full of results-driven individuals who are constantly seeking to innovate? Want to make an impact? At SailPoint, our Engineering team does just that. Our engineering is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. Our team builds products on a mature, cloud-native, event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS. SailPoint is seeking a Senior Test Engineer to join our Engineering team for Data Access Security (DAS). DAS is SailPoint’s SaaS data access governance product, delivered as part of SailPoint Agentic Fabric . It helps organizations discover, classify, and govern access to sensitive data (structured and unstructured) across cloud, SaaS, and on-premises systems — and connect that insight to human and AI identity context so customers can enforce least privilege, monitor risky activity, and streamline compliance. In this role, you are responsible for characterizing the technical quality of Data Access Security across a continuous SaaS delivery model. You will join the US team, which is part of a larger international DAS Engineering organization. You will serve as a member of a Scrum team assigned to specific product features, and you will own the development, maintenance, and execution of test cases — both in the DAS control plane (application onboarding, crawling, permissions collection, data classification, activity monitoring, forensics, certifications, and alerts) and against the connectors that reach customer data sources. You will also work directly with internal stakeholders and external customers to reproduce reported issues, isolate defects, and confirm resolution. We are looking for candidates with a strong work ethic who can work with a team of very experienced Developers and Testers, both locally in the US and with colleagues across our international DAS organization. Lack of experience in a particular technology or platform is not a showstopper as long as there is a skill of immediate usefulness, as well as a commitment to continual learning. Skills • Minimum 6 years experience testing enterprise software, preferably SaaS or cloud-native products • Experience testing distributed systems (APIs, microservices, asynchronous/event-driven workflows) • Proven ability to develop and maintain test cases • Proven ability to work with software development engineers for problem reproduction and resolution • Proven ability to design and execute end-to-end tests across UI, APIs, and data outcomes (crawl results, permissions, classification, activity events) • Proven ability to successfully relate to varying levels of functional and technical personnel • Excellent written and verbal communication skills Highly desirable • Familiarity with C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, JSON, and XML • Experience with REST API testing (Postman or similar) • Experience with SQL and one or more database platforms (SQL Server strongly preferred; Oracle, MySQL, or similar also valuable) • Experience with Microsoft 365 (SharePoint Online, OneDrive), cloud file storage (Box, Google Drive, AWS S3), data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks), or on-prem file/NAS systems (Windows File Server, NetApp, SMB) • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, or Kafka-based services • Experience with identity governance, access certifications, or data classification Location This position is based in Austin, Texas, on the US DAS team, which is part of SailPoint’s international Data Access Security Engineering organization. Education BA/BS or equivalent experience Roadmap for success: 30 days : Complete onboarding and gain foundational familiarity with the SailPoint Data Access Security architecture, Agentic Fabric concepts, and AWS-hosted event-driven microservices environment. Set up your local and cloud testing environments, integrating with team workflows and CI/CD testing pipelines. Shadow team members during sprint cycles and execute 10 or more existing manual or automated regression test suites across the DAS control plane and connectors. 60 days: Assume direct ownership of quality assurance deliverables for your assigned Scrum feature team, actively participating in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and test estimation. title: Technical Success Manager
jd_text: Say hello to opportunities. If you’re looking to be part of what’s next in communication, you’re in the right place. At RingCentral, we believe the best customer experiences happen when humans and AI work together. Our agentic voice AI portfolio—AIR, AVA, and ACE—brings together automation, assistance, and insights across the entire conversation lifecycle. The result? More seamless, intelligent experiences for businesses everywhere. With $2.5B+ in ARR and $250M invested in R&D annually, we’re building the future of AI-powered business communications. The Technical Success Manager (TSM) is RingCentral's unified post-sales relationship owner — the deliberate merger of the Customer Success Manager (CSM) and Technical Account Manager (TAM) functions into a single, high-accountability role. The TSM is a dedicated customer advocate who entirely owns the post-sales customer relationship and is fully accountable for all success and operational outcomes. Large, complex, high-ARR accounts require one authoritative voice who understands their business at the executive level and their platform at the architecture level. The TSM is funded through a customer-paid service agreement, meaning their mandate is pure advocacy. They do not carry a sales quota, do not upsell, and do not negotiate renewals. Their focus is to ensure that every assigned customer is successful, healthy, and renewal-ready. Commercial outcomes (retention and expansion) are the natural consequence of doing that job excellently. Core Responsibilities Account Ownership & Relationship Management ● Own an assigned portfolio post-sale, serving as the sole named point of accountability for each customer's success with RingCentral's UCaaS, CCaaS, and Agentic AI platforms. ● Build and maintain multi-threaded executive relationships within each account (VP, SVP, and C-suite level), ensuring RingCentral is embedded in the customer's strategic planning. ● Develop and actively maintain a documented account map detailing key contacts, decision-makers, champions, and detractors. ● Be the customer's internal advocate, representing their interests, priorities, and concerns in every internal RingCentral conversation. Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) ● Lead quarterly EBRs presenting a structured business value narrative: ROI realized, product utilization benchmarks, platform health, open risk items, and a forward-looking joint success plan. ● Own the EBR lifecycle from preparation through execution and follow-through — building the deck, facilitating the meeting, capturing action items, and closing commitments. ● Ensure 100% of assigned accounts receive an EBR on cadence every quarter without exception. Success Planning & Renewal Readiness ● Create and maintain a living Account Success Plan (ASP) for each customer, containing documented goals, milestones, risks, joint commitments, and adoption targets. ● Drive renewal readiness by ensuring every assigned account is health-scored, outcome-validated, and commercially aligned at least 90 days prior to renewal. ● Partner with Sales at the appropriate time on renewals, providing a clear health narrative and supporting the value conversation without participating in contract negotiations. ● Flag at-risk accounts early through proactive risk identification rather than waiting for lagging churn indicators. Technical Oversight & Incident Management ● Maintain a working understanding of each customer's RingCentral deployment: platform configuration, integration points, user footprint, open issues, and recent change history. ● Monitor the case portfolio for assigned accounts to track aging tickets, escalation status, and SLA adherence. ● During critical incidents, outages, or major bugs: join bridge calls, communicate proactively with customer technical leads, and provide executive-level summaries to customer leadership. ● Review post-incident Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) for accuracy and completeness, representing the customer's perspective in post-incident reviews. AI Adoption & Platform Value ● Actively drive adoption of RingCentral's AI capabilities, including NOVA, RingSense/ACE, AI Receptionist, and RingCX AI features. ● Translate AI platform capabilities into specific, measurable business outcomes for each customer. ● Ensure every assigned account has a documented AI adoption roadmap as part of their Account Success Plan. Champion Development & Cross-Functional Collaboration ● Identify, cultivate, and maintain customer champions at multiple levels, including operational power users, mid-level managers, and executive sponsors. ● Serve as the voice of the customer in internal forums (Product, Engineering, Support) to ensure feedback influences the product roadmap and operational changes. ● Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene, logging all customer interactions, health scores, risk flags, and action items within 24 hours. Technical Knowledge & Platform Fluency The TSM does not need to be a network engineer, but they must be technically credible and able to engage fluently with a customer's IT Director and CIO without requiring translation. UCaaS Fundamentals ● VoIP architecture, SIP trunking, PSTN connectivity, and cloud telephony fundamentals. ● Network considerations for voice quality: QoS, jitter, latency, bandwidth planning, and common failure modes. ● Directory integration: Active Directory/Azure AD, SSO/SAML, and provisioning patterns. ● RingCentral product portfolio: RingEX (MVP), RingCX, RingSense/ACE, NOVA, and AI Receptionist. CCaaS & Contact Center ● Contact center architecture: ACD routing, IVR/IVA design, omnichannel delivery (voice, chat, email, social), and queue management. ● Workforce management concepts: scheduling, adherence, forecasting, and real-time monitoring. ● Contact center reporting: KPI frameworks (FCR, AHT, CSAT, ASA), BI integrations, and operational analytics. ● Familiarity with the competitive CCaaS landscape (e.g., NICE CXone, Genesys, Five9, Zoom) sufficient to contextualize RingCentral's positioning. Agentic AI & Automation ● Conversational AI and virtual agent concepts: intent classification, dialogue management, fallback handling, and live agent handoffs. ● AI-assisted agent tools: real-time transcription, auto-summarization, next-best-action, and sentiment scoring. ● RingCentral NOVA and RingSense/ACE capabilities — deployment patterns, use case mapping, and outcome measurement. Integrations & Ecosystem ● CRM integration patterns: Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Microsoft Dynamics — screen pop, activity logging, and workflow triggers. ● API concepts at a functional level: REST, webhooks, and authentication (OAuth) sufficient to facilitate conversations between customer IT and RingCentral engineering. ● Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace ecosystem context: Teams integration, co-existence models, and identity federation. Experience & Qualifications Required ● 5–8 years in a customer-facing post-sales role (CSM, TAM, Solutions Consultant, or Technical Account Executive) within a SaaS, UCaaS, or CCaaS environment. ● Demonstrated track record managing complex Enterprise B2B accounts with high ARR, multi-stakeholder structures, and technically sophisticated environments. ● Proven executive relationship management experience working directly with VP and C-suite stakeholders. ● Experience independently preparing and delivering executive-level business reviews or QBRs. ● Ability to operate with strong technical credibility alongside customer IT teams. ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills tailored for executive briefings. ● Salesforce or equivalent CRM profici ency with disciplined data hygiene. Preferred ● Prior experience specifically with UCaaS or CCaaS platforms (RingCentral, NICE CXone, Genesys, Five9, Zoom, or comparable). ● Experience navigating account recovery: at-risk accounts, post-incident relationship repair, and competitive displacement responses. ● Familiarity with customer success tooling (Gainsight, Totango, Vitally, or equivalent). ● Technical certification such as CCNA, AWS Solutions Architect, or an equivalent UCaaS/CCaaS certification ● Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience. What we offer: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSAs) and Commuter benefits 401K match and ESPP Paid time off and paid sick leave Paid parental and pregnancy leave and new parent gift boxes Family-forming benefits (IVF, Preservation, Adoption etc.) Emergency backup care (Child/Adult/Pets) Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counseling sessions available 24/7 Free legal services that provide legal advice, document creation and estate planning Employee bonus referral program Student loan refinancing assistance Employee perks and discounts program RingCentral’s work culture is the backbone of our success. And don’t just take our word for it: we are recognized as a Best Place to Work by Glassdoor, the Top Work Culture by Comparably and hold local BPTW awards in every major location. Bottom line: We are committed to hiring and retaining great people because we know you power our success. About RingCentral RingCentral is a global leader in agentic voice AI–powered business communications, delivering an integrated platform for business phone, SMS, contact center, workforce engagement management, video collaboration, and messaging. As the communications layer connecting businesses and customers, RingCentral is the front door of business communication and is in the advantageous position to apply AI at every phase of the conversation journey — before, during, and after each interaction. Our agentic AI portfolio includes autonomous voice-first AI agents that automate calls, assist in the moment, and analyze every interaction – enabling businesses to work smarter, respond faster, and connect more meaningfully with their customers. title: Senior Partner Development Manager
jd_text: We’re looking for a Senior Partner Development Manager - NAMER + US Public Sector to join Procore’s Partner Strategy & Ops Organization. Your primary goal will be to own, activate, and grow high-value channel and delivery partners while collaborating with sales to unlock new market opportunities across North America and the US Public Sector. As a Senior Partner Development Manager - NAMER + US Public Sector, you’ll partner with Channel Sales, Enablement, RevOps, Legal, and Marketing to align regional growth strategies, conduct joint account planning, and drive pipeline acceleration. Use your commercial acumen, executive relationship skills, and deep ecosystem expertise to scale partner-generated revenue and influence global partner programs. Join a high-impact team expanding our footprint across key commercial and government sectors—apply today! This position reports into the VP of Channel Partners and can be based remotely in the US, with Austin, TX preferred. We’re looking for someone to join us immediately. What you’ll do: Own a strategic portfolio of channel and delivery partners across NAMER and the US Public Sector, serving as the primary executive relationship owner. Recruit, onboard, enable, and activate high-value partners—including resellers in emerging markets—aligned to regional growth objectives. Partner closely with Channel Sales to execute joint account planning, pipeline creation, and deal acceleration. Develop joint business plans, executive engagement frameworks, and regional go-to-market strategies. Lead regular partner business reviews and track key performance metrics to ensure partners deliver measurable revenue impact. Act as the voice of the region by gathering market insights and sharing feedback with leadership to shape global partner investments. Maintain clear reporting on partner performance, sales pipelines, and enablement milestones using CRM and PRM platforms. What we’re looking for: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical work experience. 8+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or partner management within a B2B SaaS organization. Proven track record of identifying, establishing, and managing resellers, distributors, system integrators (SIs), and fulfillment partners. Deep familiarity with the NAMER commercial market and the US Public Sector ecosystem. Demonstrated ability to build executive-level relationships, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and drive joint business plans. Strong technical and operational proficiency with Salesforce (or similar CRMs) and Partner Relationship Management (PRM) software. Exceptional commercial acumen with a verified track record of growing partner-generated revenue and pipeline. Full written and verbal fluency in English; bilingual Spanish capabilities are a plus. title: Regional Operations Manager (Orthodontic / Dental)
jd_text: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. Location: Field-Based Dallas-Fort Worth Metropolitan Area (Assigned Territory) Company: Rock Dental Brands About Us At Rock Dental Brands, we operate on a simple principle: we serve those who serve patients . Every role in our organization exists to support our doctors and clinical teams. We don't have a corporate office—we have a Solutions Center dedicated to solving problems, removing friction, and helping practices grow. We operate with absolute transparency, trust, accountability, and data-driven decision-making. We are growing rapidly and looking for a strong, autonomous Regional Operations Manager (AM) who doesn't wait for perfect direction, but instead steps in to identify issues, align resources, and drive action for their doctors and clinical teams. Purpose of the Role The Regional Operations Manager is the critical connector, translator, and operator between our clinics and the Solutions Center. This role doesn’t exist to micromanage from a computer screen; it exists to help our doctors and teams succeed. You will implement the operational infrastructure that allows clinics to perform consistently, creating visibility and developing practice leaders before operational problems become crises. Core Responsibilities & Pillars Operational Leadership: Maintain a pulse on clinic performance, staffing, morale, and operational risks. You will get into clinics early and often, identifying trends and moving issues quickly toward resolution. Leadership Development: Develop Practice Managers into strong operational leaders. Your job is not to personally fix everything, but to coach teams through accountability and execution—building capability instead of dependency. Doctor Partnership: Build deep trust and credibility with our doctors. You will ensure they feel supported, heard, and informed, removing operational barriers so they can focus entirely on patient care. KPI Accountability: Use performance data to drive meaningful conversations, understand the root drivers of performance (not just the outcomes), and ensure clinics are focused on the right priorities. Solutions Center Partnership: Act as the bridge between the field and support teams. Escalate issues early and clearly, ensuring the right teams are solving the right problems to drive company initiatives forward. What "Great" Looks Like in This Role The best Regional Managers make the role their own and leave every clinic stronger than they found it. You are a great fit if you can seamlessly balance relationships (to create trust) with data (to create clarity) , and can communicate clearly at any given moment: Which clinics are winning, which are at risk, and why . Which leaders need development, and which are ready for the next step. What operational issues or KPIs are moving and what is driving them. What to Avoid: If you prefer managing from a distance, relying solely on email communications, or waiting for perfect instruction before taking action, this is not the role for you. Qualifications 3+ years of multi-unit operations management experience (Dental, Orthodontic, or healthcare hospitality preferred). Proactive Ownership: A proven track record of showing initiative and ownership of a region, learning a business deeply, and driving action without a micromanaging leader. Data Literacy: Ability to look past the surface numbers to understand operational drivers and apply analytics to process improvement. Strong Communication & Presence: Exceptional face-to-face relationship-building skills with both administrative staff and doctors. Travel: Ability to travel 60% – 70% of the time to be present in your clinics within the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. Benefits & Culture We promote a healthy work-life balance and provide a supportive environment built on mutual respect and leadership development. Our benefits package includes: Employer-contributed health insurance. 401(k) with company match (eligible after one year). Paid Time Off (PTO) with no waiting period. Holiday pay with no waiting period. Performance-Based Bonus: Tied directly to operational outcomes within the region.

title: RVP of Enterprise Sales
jd_text: SailPoint is the leader in Identity Security . SailPoint customers represent half of the Fortune 500 and half of the ASX 50 . This customer strength provides us with a great community of customers, partners and analysts who trust SailPoint and our team to solve complex challenges. SailPoint continues to grow globally and expanding our global presence creates opportunities for top salespeople to become a part of our awesome culture . We are recognized by analysts such as Gartner, Forester and Kuppinger Cole as the leader in the market and we continue to push ourselves to define the market rather than follow what the analysts or competitors are marketing. Organizations struggle to understand who has access to what applications and data, and we help them answer these key questions. Identity security is the central control point for risk management for the enterprise. We are proud of our team and the culture we have built which has led to our employees voting us “best places to work” – 15 years in a row. The role: We are seeking a RVP of Enterprise to s ell our Identity Security Solutions. We are searching for a Leader of our Enterprise organisation . This will include both direct management of the Enterprise sales team and matrix leadership of the associated supporting functions . This position is responsible for managing a team of sales professionals who sell to end users directly and leverage the support of our influential channel partners in selling our market leading IGA Solution Suite . Primarily a SaaS offering, our IGA Solution Suite sits at the heart of an organisation's enterprise security . The position requires someone with a successful track record of leading sales teams within high growth S aa S or Cyber-sec organisations , and ideally someone who has lead sales during a transition from on-prem to SaaS . Our sales managers bring structure and rigour to all aspects of the sales process including pipeline and forecasting whilst also acting as inspirational leader to their teams . The path to success: The activities of first few months are critical to creating the desired impact and acceleration of the business within your region. 1 -m onth milestones : First month is likely to be more internally focused. Approach onboarding sessions with a clear plan to maximize their value and ensure you gain the necessary insights. Evaluate the status quo within your reporting structure, consisting of detailed analysis of People; Process; Cadence; Structure . Work with T alent Acquisition to identify candidates for any open req uisitions and develop a plan/pipeline to address any potential backfill req ui s itions . Coordinate meetings with key leadership and relevant peers, ensuring thorough preparation to maximize their value Engage with and establish relationships with key supporting functions beyond your immediate reporting structure. Familiarize yourself with our products, success stories, and key differentiators. You should be confident in articulating the SailPoint value proposition Passed “1 st Mate” enablement badge . 2-month milestones : During your second month your focus should begin to move beyond your immediate team: Evaluate the status quo within the non-direct support structure, consisting of detailed analysis of People; Process; Cadence; Structure. Evaluate the status quo within your install base, your target Customers & your Partners. Begin to arrange meetings with Customers & Partners Evaluate the quality of the pipeline & the forecasting process, looking for immediate and long-term opportunities for improvement . 3-month milestones : Develop a 12-month plan for your business, broken down by milestones, underpinned with primary actions required to attain the goals. Present the business plan to your manager & the region-specific Leadership Team Identify the first of any new hires that you intend to make and have start dates confirmed. Develop plans with marketing and the partner team to show the white space opportunities in your existing customers + potential new logo opportunities + identify potential customers with compliance/governance requirements and/or business drivers requiring an IGA solution. Passed “Sailing Master” and “Quarter Master” enablement badges . 6-month milestones : Develop a 3-year plan for your business, broken down by milestones, underpinned with primary actions required to attain the goals. Your People; Process; Cadence; Structure should have been adjusted & refined to support your plan. Ability t o demonstrate where you have already moved the needle and the improvement of process and/or results in relation to these four areas of focus. Acquired “Captain” enablement badge . 12-month milest ones : By the end of your first year, you should be on track with established plans and have built a strong foundation for sustained growth. At this stage, you should refine and update your three-year plan based on your current position. Reassess and enhance the People, Process, Cadence, and Structure—both direct and indirect—to ensure continued alignment with overall goals and the ability to execute effectively. Maintain rigor within the forecasting process, ensuring ongoing accuracy and reliability in projections. Collaborate with marketing and the partner team to identify white-space opportunities within existing accounts, uncover potential new customer prospects , new logo opportunities , and pinpoint organizations with compliance, governance, or business drivers necessitating an IGA solution. Ensure that pipeline is 3x quota. Benefits and Compensation listed vary based on the location of your employment and the nature of your employment with SailPoint. title: Vice President, Partnerships
jd_text: The Vice President, Partnerships will define and lead Procore’s global partnerships and ecosystem strategy, evaluating existing capabilities and partnerships across product areas and shaping the ecosystem of the future.
